name: field-finance-payout-governance
objective: Close Field finance on WLT with policy-driven approved-work commissions, governed payout and offboarding settlement, and remove every Field COD/incident/penalty path.
truthOwner: WLT owns Field wallet, ledger, commission, payout destination/request/reservation/execution/reconciliation and offboarding settlement.

tasks.objective: Make WLT the only Field financial truth and delete financially/operationally cancelled Field concepts.
tasks.currentProblem: Wallet/payout ownership is largely correct, but Field UI still renders Provider incidents and backend/shared routes support incidents/penalties; COD was incorrectly considered in prior Field scope. Commission triggers/eligibility and payout/offboarding policies require one governed model.
tasks.requiredChange: Remove ProviderIncidentsPanel and Field-facing incident/appeal/penalty state/routes/types/tests; delete shared dead incident/penalty code only when no legitimate non-Field consumer remains, otherwise isolate it outside Field. Exclude all COD paths. Define commission events by WLT policy and credit only after evidence/result approval; corrections use reversal/adjustment. Finance owns masked verified payout destination and configurable min/max/frequency/fee policy; Field requests FULL_AVAILABLE/SPECIFIED; approve→execute→verify/complete remains auditable. On termination cut access immediately and create/continue offboarding settlement until money is reconciled.
tasks.targetState: Field sees only wallet, ledger, commissions and payout; no incident/penalty/COD vocabulary or endpoint is reachable from Field. Every commission references approved source+policy snapshot, every correction is append-only, every payout uses one verified WLT destination/version and eligible amount exactly once, and terminated providers can settle funds without application access.
tasks.action: Inventory WLT/Workforce/DSH finance and incident writers/readers plus Control Panel finance tabs; remove/cut Field incident/COD graph, centralize commission/payout/offboarding policy and event contracts, add idempotency/reconciliation/maker-checker tests, then verify shared Partner/Captain payout regression only where the same contract changed.
mustNotChange: لا COD داخل Field بأي شكل.
لا Field incidents/penalties أو auto deductions.
لا تعديل/حذف ledger entry تاريخي؛ reversal/adjustment فقط.
acceptanceCriteria: Field code/routes/UI no longer expose COD/incidents/penalties and dead shared remnants are removed when safe.
Commission events are policy-driven and require approved evidence/result.
Payout destination is Finance-owned/masked and policy limits/fees are server authoritative.
Approve/execute/verify and unknown provider result reconcile exactly once.
Termination revokes access immediately while offboarding settlement can finish independently.
tasks.rollback: Financial truth is forward-fixed; never restore cancelled Field incident/COD concepts or mutate historical ledger lines.
tasks.commitBoundary: Field financial authority and cancelled-concept cleanup as one coherent WLT boundary batch.
